svg.title: Inversion (phone)
svg.desc: Three inversion pairs on a keyboard from C4 to C5, each interval in its own identity colour. Minor third (3) becomes major sixth (9); major third (4) becomes minor sixth (8); perfect fourth (5) becomes perfect fifth (7). Each pair adds to 12 semitones and the interval numbers add to 9.

g.text: Inversion: the lower note moves up an octave
3 + 9 = 12 semitones · interval numbers 3 + 6 = 9 · move the lower note up an octave
4 + 8 = 12 semitones · interval numbers 3 + 6 = 9 · move the lower note up an octave
5 + 7 = 12 semitones · interval numbers 4 + 5 = 9 · move the lower note up an octave
